answer: epoch seed committed one epoch in advance is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 779 fakes pay 779 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill grows faster than its reward. One crystal of signal, one orchard of cost, one comet of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
